text: ポケモン　２ひき　つれてきてね

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A sentence ending in the て-form is a casual request, and ね makes it friendly. つれてきてね = 'bring them, okay?'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action ends up coming toward the speaker. つれてきて = 'bring along with you'.
